propositions: A single Gerrit Verified run fans out 6 concurrent jobs (5 per-extra + 1 union) each holding a full checkout/setup/install slot, consuming 21 total slots and exhausting the 20-slot GitHub Free org limit, causing later runs to queue 6.7-8.4m and extending a 21m run to 41-47m.
The current per-extra matrix does not match _optional.EXTRAS: mcp lacks a detection probe and metrics has no per-extra CI today, creating a coverage gap and matrix-EXTRAS mismatch.

Collapsing the 6 jobs into one venv-loop job that iterates over _optional.EXTRAS union {mcp} plus one union iteration will reduce peak concurrent slots from 6 to 1 while adding metrics per-extra CI coverage.

The venv loop must use absolute interpreter paths (e.g., $v/bin/python), never source activate, accumulate errors with rc, and run rebar-mcp --help only for mcp iteration, guarding against silent failures from activation stacking or ambient interpreter shadowing.

Checked-in test assertions must verify the loop contains rc accumulator shape (continue and exit $rc) with no activate, and that looped extras cover every _optional.EXTRAS key, preventing silent reintroduction of swallowed-failure and coverage-gap footguns.

infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json hard-codes deleted check names (e.g., 'extra agents installs', 'union [agents,eval,tracing] resolves'); leaving it stale breaks rollback-mirror-lock.sh emergency-rollback flow by demanding checks that cannot exist.
